_meta.model_rule: New motion uses KIE kling-3.0/video. Kling 2.6 is retired.
_meta.duration_rule: Render Kling clips as 5s or 10s units, then trim editorially to each shot duration.
_meta.talking_rule: Prefer Kling 3.0 performance plus ElevenLabs VO-over. Avoid Kling AI-Avatar unless a short line passes full-duration tooth/smile QA.
_meta.prompt_safety: Continuous non-looping performance, no repeated gesture, no freeze-frame, no visible restart. Bentley mouth closed or tiny dark puppy-mouth opening only; no visible teeth, gums, grin, lip-corner smile, or human smile. Indi has a tiny round toothless cephalopod mouth, no lips, teeth, gums, nose, brows, snout, ears, paws, fur, collar, or tag. Express emotion through eyes, ears, head tilt, body bounce, tail-stub wiggle, ring spots, arms, and body posture.
